idea: 将输入2的双字段差异绝对值转化为动态置信度权重：差异越小（数据质量越高），赋予越接近0.05的权重系数；差异超过5%则权重归零。该权重与输入1的美国敞口行业标准化值相乘，实现'数据一致性调节信号强度'的自适应机制，避免低质量数据干扰主信号。
expression_list: multiply(group_zscore(winsorize(ts_backfill(rsk74_raw_exp_usa, 21), std=4), industry), trade_when(less(abs(subtract(rsk74_raw_exp_nondomicile1, rsk74_raw_exp_nondomicile2)), 0.05), subtract(0.05, abs(subtract(rsk74_raw_exp_nondomicile1, rsk74_raw_exp_nondomicile2))), 0))

multiply(group_zscore(winsorize(ts_backfill(rsk74_raw_exp_usa, 21), std=4), industry), trade_when(less(abs(subtract(rsk74_raw_exp_nondomicile1, rsk74_std_exp_nondomicile2)), 0.05), subtract(0.05, abs(subtract(rsk74_raw_exp_nondomicile1, rsk74_std_exp_nondomicile2))), 0))
